populated_legacy_upgrade.expected_failure_path: Ambiguous, inactive, invalid, or duplicate provider identity must never grant broad clinic membership; legitimate manual and unrelated memberships must survive correction.

transitional_workflow_rediscovery.expected_failure_path: An unclassified document must remain institution-scoped, rediscoverable after reload, atomically classifiable once, and absent from standard clinical reads until review.
test_ids: DB-backed source classification is one-way and clinical read does not open billing

cross_scope_dto_projection.expected_failure_path: Episode appointments from the same institution may be operationally visible, but nested patient identity, contact data, and clinical free text must not cross clinic scope.

context_initialization.expected_failure_path: The dashboard must not query before clinic context is ready, must derive today from the active clinic timezone, and must reject stale clinic responses.
test_ids: waits for the active clinic timezone before requesting the clinic-local day
clinic switch recalculates auto-today without querying the stale clinic day
midnight rollover issues one new auto-today request

deployment_proxy_boundary.expected_failure_path: An untrusted direct client must not turn spoofed forwarding headers into persisted audit provenance, while the bounded reverse-proxy hop remains supported.
